messages:
sarah_sales: Heads-up — AstraMetrics just dropped a SIG/CAIQ PDF in the intake form during POC signup. Kickoff for the POC is Wed 9am PT and SEs need high-level answers on encryption, network isolation, and data residency before the demo. Can security triage & assign? cc @alex_security @devon_se

alex_security: On it. Can you paste the customer contact and which specific controls are blocking the POC? :eyes:

sarah_sales: Contact: j.martin@astrametrics.com / +1-415-555-0123. Main blockers: 1) Customer-managed keys (BYOK) on Dedicated 2) EU data residency confirmation 3) SSO/SCIM details for access controls. POC will ingest sample PHI-ish data — need guidance on that flow.

alex_security: Assigning to @priya_security. I'll create an intake record and link to Jira. ETA for initial triage 48–72h. Flagging PHI -> may need compliance escalation. :lock:

priya_security: Thanks — grabbing the doc now. Quick clarifying Qs: a) Is the POC on hosted or Dedicated? b) Do they want contractual artifacts (DPA/BAA) or just operational answers? c) Did they circle any CAIQ sections in particular? If PHI is involved, confirm whether they expect a BAA for the POC or only if going to prod.

devon_se: POC is on Dedicated trial in eu-west-1. They explicitly called out BYOK for testing crypto at rest, and circled "network segmentation" + "audit logs" in the questionnaire. I can share the environment details for the POC cluster.

sarah_sales: Confirmed: Dedicated trial. They asked for temporary BYOK via KMS for the POC. BAA not requested yet but likely after successful trial. For now they need confirmation that AES-256 at-rest + TLS in transit + audit logging are available.

priya_security: Preliminary answers we can provide immediately: - TLS in transit: YES (TLS 1.2+ enforced) - Audit logging: YES (console events + syslog/forwarding available) - Customer-managed keys on Dedicated: SUPPORTED via KMS integration (see docs) I'll draft short, customer-facing answers and flag contractual items separately. ETA: end of day tomorrow for draft. If PHI will be ingested in prod we will require a signed BAA before onboarding.

priya_security: Sample snippet I'll include in the draft (non-contractual): `We support customer-managed keys on Dedicated clusters through KMS integration. Example config: kmsKey: "projects/PROJECT/locations/global/keyRings/kr/cryptoKeys/key1". Data at rest is encrypted with AES-256; TLS 1.2+ is enforced for all control and data plane traffic.`

ruth_support: Created Jira SECURITY-7890 and linked the intake. Adding @priya_security as assignee and tagging the POC. :white_check_mark:

alex_security: Great. @sarah_sales please forward any legal redlines if they send them. @priya_security if you need access to logs or the POC cluster, ping eng-infra or infra-oncall.

priya_security: Noted. I'll separate operational answers vs contractual asks and send both. Expect initial reply by 2025-03-25 EOD. :calendar:

riskbot: AUTOMATION: Intake SEC-2024-789 created and linked to Jira SECURITY-7890. Owner: priya_security. Priority: P1-Pilot. https://redwood.internal/sec/SEC-2024-789

sarah_sales: Awesome — thanks team. I'll notify the customer that security is triaging and ask them to upload any network diagrams or encryption requirements. :rocket:
